ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and remind the driver that the 'I'm Here' button must be pressed at the pickup before any no-show cancellation — GPS showed the vehicle stationary ~250 m from the pin, never inside the pickup radius, and driver_pressed_here_at is null.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver asserts he waited 4 minutes at the pickup and cancelled as a no-show, but driver_pressed_here_at is null and the GPS trace shows him stationary ~250 m from the pickup pin, never within the 200 m arrival radius — NS-1 (i) and (ii) both fail, so the no-show fee does not stand.
